structured_output.summary: The diff implements Set.prototype.intersection in its own file, with each spec step kept as a comment above its code. I walked the spec steps in order and found no defects. GetSetRecord is a local helper, and the diff says so. Step ordering, the `?` propagation and the observable Get/ToNumber/Call/GetIteratorFromMethod/IteratorStepValue operations all match the spec. The two branches (size comparison, and iterating the keys iterator) follow the spec's index and thisSize handling, including updating thisSize only for non-empty entries. The gate's 32 not-implemented results come from unimplemented dependencies (Set/Map size getters, SetIteratorPrototype.next), which the engine correctly reports as not-implemented, so they are not defects in this change.
